title: Psalm 1
Psalm 2
lyrics:
Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?
The kings of earth together with rulers stand arrayed
against the Lord and also ’gainst His Anointed One:
“Let’s break their chains and fetters; with their rule we are done!”

The One enthroned in heaven just laughs and scoffs at them,
And then He speaks in anger; in wrath opposes them:
“I’ve set My King in Zion, upon My holy hill.”
He said, “You are My Son; and today begotten still.”

“O, ask of me, I’ll give you the nations as your own;
The ends of earth I’ll grant you, for you and you alone.
You’ll rule them with a scepter and dash them to the ground;
Like pottery in pieces, their pride I will confound.”

Therefore, O kings, show wisdom, be warned you lords of earth;
And serve the Lord with trembling; rejoice at His great worth.
O kiss the Son and bow down, lest wrath destroy your way;
Though it flare up, bless’d are those who make Him all their stay.

title: Psalm 3
lyrics:
O Lord, how my foes have increased!
How many rise up against me!
They say, “There is no help in God,
There’s no deliv’rance for his plea.”Selah

But You, Lord, are my strength and shield,
My glory, who my head lifts still.
Unto the Lord I cry aloud;
He answers from His holy hill.Selah

And as for me, I lie and sleep;
I wake, the Lord is always near.
Though thousands come against my life,
I will not be afraid or fear.

Arise, O Lord, and save me, God!
Strike all my foes upon the jaw.
Deliv’rance comes from God the Lord,
May You bless all who on You call.Selah

title: Psalm 4
lyrics:
God, answer when I call to You,
For You are all my righteousness.
Be merciful, and hear my prayer,
O give me help in my distress.

How long, O people, will you turn
my honor into such disgrace?
How long will you love worthless lies,
And seek false gods and not God’s face?Selah

The Lord calls godly ones to Him;
The Lord hears when I call to Him.
So in your anger, do not sin,
And search your heart as day grows dim.

O ponder Him upon your bed;
Be still, and make your heart His own. Selah
Give sacrifices that are right
and trust in God the Lord alone.

So many ask, “O who can know
or show us any good at all?”
O let the light of Your face shine
upon us, Lord, who on You call.

My heart is filled with greater joy
than when new wine and grain abound.
I will lie down and sleep in peace,
For You, Lord, safely me surround.

title: Psalm 5
lyrics:
Give ear to my words, O Lord,
My deep groaning don’t ignore.
Hear and heed my pleading prayer,
As I come and seek Your care.
King and God, to You I pray;
I will watch for You this day.

In the morning, hear my voice,
In the morning, I’ll rejoice;
Bring my prayers before Your throne,
Wait in hope for You alone.
You don’t love the wrong we do,
Evil cannot dwell with You.

Pride can’t stand before Your eyes;
Those who do wrong You despise.
You destroy those who tell lies,
Men of bloodshed You chastise.
But by mercy I will come,
Humbly bow within Your home.

Lead me in Your righteousness,
For my foes cause me distress.
Make Your way straight before me;
For their words aren’t trustworthy.
Their throat is an open grave,
Heart is dark, and tongue can’t save.

Make them bear their guilt, O God;
Let them fall by their own fraud.
Banish them for all their sin,
For they have rebelled within.
By their own intrigues they fall—
Hold them guilty, God of all.

But let those who trust in You,
have great joy and sing anew.
Spread protection over them,
That they may rejoice again.
For You bless the righteous, Lord;
Keep them by Your shield and sword.

title: Psalm 6
lyrics:
O Lord, in anger don’t rebuke;
In wrath, don’t chide or turn from me.
Have mercy, Lord, for I am faint;
My bones are in great agony.

Come heal me, for my anguished soul
cries out, “How long, O Lord, how long?”
Deliver me, and save me, Lord—
Your steadfast love remains my song.

No one can praise You from the grave;
Nor mention You when they are dead.
I groan all day, all night I weep;
My tears flow free and flood my bed.

My eyes grow weak with sorrow and
they fail because of all my foes.
Depart from me, you evil ones!
The Lord has heard my cries and woes.

The Lord in mercy heard my cry;
Receives my prayer before His face.
My enemies will be dismayed
and turn back, shamed and in disgrace.

title: Psalm 6
lyrics:
Lord, don’t rebuke in wrath, or turn Your face from me.
Have mercy, Lord, for I am faint, my bones in agony.

O Lord, my anguished soul, cries out, “How long; how long?”
Deliver me, and save me, Lord—Your love remains my song.

None from the grave praise You; remember You when dead.
I groan all day, all night I weep, my tears do flood my bed.

My eyes grow weak with grief; they fail due to my foes.
Depart from me, you evil ones! The Lord has heard my woes.

The Lord has heard my cry; accepts my prayer with grace.
My enemies will be dismayed, and turned back in disgrace.

title: Psalm 7
lyrics:
O Lord, my God, in You I refuge take;
Save me from those who would pursue my life.
Like a strong li-on they would tear and shake,
Leaving no help in all my painful strife.

If, Lord my God, I’m guilty in Your sight,
If there is guilt and sin upon my hand;
If I’ve robbed friends, or evil done in spite,
Let my life be cast down at Your command.Selah

Arise, O Lord, in anger that’s replete;
Rise up against rage of my enemies.
Awake, my God, rise to Your judgment seat;
Let the assembly know of Your decrees.

The righteous Lord, He judges all the earth.
Judge me, O Lord, by my own righteousness.
Vindicate my integrity and worth,
According to my life of faithfulness.

O God, You search the hearts and minds of men.
You end the vi-o-lence of wicked ones.
Bring all their sin to its appointed end,
And keep securely all Your righteous ones.

My shield is God who saves those in the right—
The righteous judge whose wrath opposes sin.
If He does not relent, His sword will fight;
His bow is bent, and poised to strike again.

He has prepared His deadly weapons now;
He makes His arrows with their fiery shafts.
The wicked man conceives an evil vow,
Bringing to birth those sins and lies he crafts!

He digs a pit and makes it big and round;
But he falls in the pit that he has made.
His mischief turns, upon him does rebound;
Vio-lence comes on his head and he’s betrayed.

I will give thanks, which to the Lord is due;
His righteousness is over everything.
I’ll sing praise to the Lord’s name ever true—
The Lord Most High, His praises I will sing.

title: Psalm 8
Psalm 9
Psalm 10
lyrics:
Why, Lord, do You stand far away in times of trial and pain?
The wicked ones in arrogance afflict the weak for gain.
Let them be caught in schemes they plan; the wicked boast indeed!
They boast of cravings in their heart, renounce GOD, and bless greed.

In pride they do not seek Him and they think, “There is no God!”
They prosper and consider all God’s judgments as a fraud.
They sneer at foes and think these words: “For nothing can shake me.
I’ll always know this happiness, and trouble I’ll not see.”

His mouth is full of lies and threats, and evil’s on his tongue.
He waits to ambush innocent, to murder old or young.
For victims he in secret waits, like lions wait for prey;
He lurks that he may seize the poor and drag them off to slay.

He crushes helpless ones who sink and fall down hopelessly.
He says, “God has forgotten this, and He will never see.”
Arise, O Lord, lift up Your hand; forget not those in need!
Why do the wicked spurn You, God, and say, “He will not heed”?

But You, God, see our woe and grief; You take it all to mind.
The helpless ones know You’re their help; a father orphans find.
O break the arm of evil ones; call them before Your throne.
May all their deeds come into light, in judgment be made known.

The Lord is King for evermore, the nations will not stand.
O Lord, You hear the cries of all afflicted in the land.
For You defend the fatherless, and justice You’ll outpour
so that the wicked of the earth may terrify no more.

title: Psalm 11
lyrics:
In God the Lord I take refuge,
How can you say to me:
“Look, how the wicked bend their bow—
Now to your mountain flee!

“Their arrow is upon the string
with righteous ones in view;
When all foundations are destroyed,
What can the righteous do?”

The Lord is in His holy place,
The Lord is on His throne.
His eyes do see and He does test
all those whom He does own.

The Lord examines righteous ones
and tests the wicked, too.
He hates all those who love vio-lence,
and this is what He’ll do:

He’ll rain down coals of fire that will
all wickedness burn up;
Fire, brimstone, burning wind will be
the portion of their cup.

For God the Lord is righteous and
He loves true righteousness.
The upright will behold His face
and in His presence rest.

title: Psalm 12
Psalm 13
lyrics:
How long, Lord, will You forget me?
How long will You hide Your face?
How long, Lord, will this depression
grip my soul in its embrace?
How long will this dreadful sorrow
pierce my heart all night and day?
How long will my soul’s attacker
be exalted o’er my way?

Look on me, Lord, come and answer,
Light my eyes lest death approach;
Lest my enemy claim vict’ry
and my foes gloat in reproach.
But I trust Your lovingkindness,
in salvation I’ll rejoice;
For the Lord has been good to me,
I will sing with heart and voice.

title: Psalm 14
lyrics:
The fool has said within his heart, “There surely is no God.”
They are corrupt, their deeds are vile; there’s no one who does good.

The Lord looks down from heav’n upon all women and all men,
To see if any understand or seek for God within.

They all have turned aside and to corruption they have gone.
There is not one who does what’s good; no, not a single one.

Will evildoers never learn—those who with one accord
devour my people like their bread, and don’t call on the Lord?

They are in dread, for God is with the righteous among men.
The wicked shame afflicted ones; the Lord’s their refuge then.

Oh, that salvation for Isr’el would come forth from Zion!
Great joy for Jacob when the Lord restores His captive ones.

title: Psalm 15
lyrics:
Who, Lord, may dwell within Your holy place,
And live upon Your holy, righteous hill?
Those who walk blamelessly, and do what’s right,
And speak the truth from their heart ever still.

Who never slander with an evil tongue,
Nor do their neighbor any wrongful deed;
Who cast no slur on either friend or foe,
Rejecting those who walk by sinful creed.

The righteous honor those who fear the Lord;
They keep their oath, despite the hurt or pain.
aNo wicked bribe they take for a reward.
Money is lent without dishonest gain.

Who, Lord, may dwell within Your holy place?
Who live upon Your holy, righteous hill?
bThose who walk in this path and do these things,
Will not be moved or shaken from Your will.

title: Psalm 16
Psalm 17
lyrics:
Lord, hear my plea, attend my cry; unto my prayer give heed.
My righteous plea does not from false, deceitful lips proceed.

Let vindication of my cause proceed, O Lord, from You;
Your eyes see what is right, so give my vindication due.

Though You may probe my heart at night, or test me deep within;
You will find nothing, for I vowed my mouth would never sin.

As for men’s deeds, I’ve kept myself from all their violent ways;
It’s by the word of Your own lips I’ve stayed within Your ways.

My steps have held fast to Your path; I’ve walked within Your way;
And my feet have not slipped, for on Your path I vowed to stay.

I call on You, and trust, O God, that You will answer me;
Give ear to me and hear my prayer, incline Your ear to me.

Show me Your wondrous steadfast love: You save by Your right hand
all those who take refuge in You from foes that ’gainst them stand.

Keep me as safe as You would keep the apple of Your eye;
And in the shadow of Your wings, allow me safe to hide,

From wicked ones who trouble me, who do my soul surround,
From all my mortal enemies who compass me around.

They close their callous hearts, and speak with arrogance profound;
They track us down with eyes alert, to throw us to the ground.

They’re like a lion prowling ‘round, and hungry for his prey—
A lion who lies crouching under cover all the day.

Rise up and come confront my foes, and bring them down, O Lord,
Come rescue me from wicked ones by power of Your sword.

Stretch out Your hand to save me from such worldly ones, O Lord,
Who only in this present life do gather their reward.

You still the hunger of the ones You cherish, and provide
so they’ll not want; their children with great wealth will be supplied.

But as for me, in righteousness, Your face I know I’ll see;
When I awake, Your likeness will be fullest joy to me.

title: Psalm 18
lyrics:
I love You, O my Lord, my strength, my Rock and Fortress strong;
My trust for my deliverance does to the Lord belong.
My God, my Rock, in whom I trust, a refuge unto me;
The horn of my salvation and my stronghold, shield, is He.

I’ll call upon the Lord my God, who’s worthy of all praise,
And then from enemies I shall be saved through all my days.
The cords of death entangled me, destruction o’er me swept;
The grave coiled all around me, and in death’s snares I was kept.

In my distress, I called the Lord; to God my words did fly.
He from His temple heard my voice; to His ears came my cry.
The earth was frightened, and did quake, with trembling it was seized;
The hills’ foundations shook with fear, because He was displeased.

Up from His nostrils came hot smoke, and from His mouth there came
devouring fire, and coals by it burned hot with blazing flame.
He split the heavens and came down, from thence He did descend,
And thickest clouds of darkness did around His feet attend.

Upon the cherubim He rode, upon them He did fly.
Yes, on the swift wings of the wind, His flight was from on high.
The darkness was His covering: about Him, for His tent,
Dark waters were, and thickest clouds of the sky’s firmament.

Out of the brightness of that light which from His presence came,
The clouds advanced, the hailstones and the bolts of lighted flame.
The Lord God thundered from the sky, from heaven with great ire;
The voice of the Most High did come with hail and coals of fire.

He shot His arrows far abroad, and scattered all the foes;
With lightning bolts He routed those who had the Lord opposed.
The valleys of the sea were seen, the world’s foundations vast;
At Your rebuke, Lord, all laid bare before Your nostrils’ blast.

Then from above, the Lord reached down, and took me from below;
He drew me forth from waters deep, which would me overflow.
He rescued me from enemies, from foes who hated me;
Because He saw they were too strong; their pow’r too great for me.

They did confront me in the day of my calamity,
But even then the Lord was there—a strong support to me.
He brought me to a spacious place, and rescue to me brought;
Because He took delight in me, He my deliv’rance wrought.

According to my righteousness, the Lord gave recompense;
He did reward according to my hands’ pure innocence.
For I have kept the Lord God’s ways, and not lived wickedly;
His laws are set before me; I don’t turn from His decrees.

Sincere before Him is my heart; I have walked blamelessly
and watchfully I’ve kept myself from all iniquity.
According to my righteousness, the Lord rewards aright;
According to the cleanness of my hands within His sight.

You’re faithful to the faithful ones, to upright ones upright;
Pure to the pure, but shrewd to those whose path turns from the light.
For You will save the humble ones, who low in grief do lie;
But You bring low the arrogant who have a haughty eye.

For You, Lord, light my lamp so that it burns and shines so bright;
And You, my God, will also turn my darkness into light.
With Your help, I run through a troop, advance against them all;
And by my God assisting me, I leap and scale a wall.

As for my God, His way is right; His word is true and tried.
He is a refuge to all those who do in Him confide.
For who is God besides the Lord? Who is a rock and stay?
’Tis God who girds me with His strength, and perfect makes my way.

He makes my feet swift as the deer; on heights helps me to stand.
My arms can bend a bow of bronze; for war, He trains my hand.
You’ve given me salvation’s shield, for vic-to-ry I wait;
Your right hand holds me up and You stoop down to make me great.

You gave a broad place for my steps, a wide path under me,
So that my footsteps would not slip—my feet can walk safely.
My enemies I did pursue and overtook them all,
Nor did I turn back till they were consumed and they did fall.

I crushed them so they could not rise; they fell beneath my feet.
You armed me with Your strength for war; my foes You did defeat.
You made my enemy turn back—my foe before me flies;
So I destroyed all of my foes who did against me rise.

They cried for help, but there was none that would or could them save.
Yes, they did cry unto the Lord, but He no answer gave.
Then I did beat them fine as dust before the wind that flies,
And I did cast them out like dirt upon the street that lies.

You saved me from attack, and You o’er nations have placed me;
A people whom I have not known are subject now to me.
When they hear me, they will obey, and foreigners submit;
They all lose heart, and trembling come from strongholds where they sit.

The Lord God lives, bless’d be my Rock; exalted be my God!
He does avenge me, and subdues the nations far abroad.
He saves me from my enemies—yes, You have lifted me
above my foes; and from the men of vio-lence set me free.

Therefore, to You I will give thanks ’mid nations great and small.
I will sing praises to Your name, O Lord, the King of all.
He gives deliv’rance to His king; His mercy does extend
to David, His anointed, and descendants without end.

title: Psalm 19
lyrics:
The heavens are telling the glory of God, and
the skies are declaring the work of His hands.
For day after day they speak, pouring forth knowledge, and
night after night is displayed their expanse.
Their voice is not heard—there’s no speech and no word, but
their sound has gone forth to the earth’s farthest end.
The sun in the heaven comes forth like a bridegroom;
The Lord for a race does His champion send.

It rises at one end of heaven and travels;
Its circuit extends over all of the earth.
And nothing is hidden from its heat or glory,
And like it, God’s law shines with power and worth.
The law of the Lord is most perfect and holy,
Reviving the soul and restoring the heart.
The statutes of God can be trusted most surely;
They make wise the simple and truth do impart.
The precepts of God are right, giving the heart joy;

Commands of the Lord are pure, lighting the eyes.
The fear of the Lord is enduring forever;
His judgments are true and right, making us wise.
They are much more precious than gold, and much sweeter
than honey and honeycomb where honey’s stored;
Moreover, by them is Your servant instructed.
In keeping Your statutes, there is great reward.

But who can discern his own faults and his errors?
Forgive all my hidden sins—let them not rule!
Then I will be blameless, complete, and acquitted
of every transgression that besets the fool.
May all of the words of my mouth and the thoughts of
my heart be accepted O Lord, in Your sight;
O Lord, my sure Rock and my precious Redeemer,
May my life be pleasing and lived in Your light.

title: Psalm 19
lyrics:
The heavens declare the glory of God;
The skies do proclaim the works of His hands.
For day after day their speech loudly pours forth,
And night after night knowledge rings out and stands.

Like language and speech throughout the whole world,
So there is no place their voice is not heard.
Their voice goes out unto the ends of the earth;
The whole world proclaiming His almighty word!

The sun from his tent in heaven above
comes forth like a bridegroom, mounting the sky.
It’s like a great champ-i-on running his course,
With joy as it travels its circuit on high!

It rises to shine from heaven’s far end;
Its circuit extends throughout the whole day.
There’s nothing on earth that can hide from its heat;
Great warmth is enjoyed by all under its sway.

The law of the Lord is perfect and sound,
For with it the soul is revived and crowned.
His statutes are trustworthy, making us wise;
His precepts are right and they make joy abound.

Commands of the Lord are radiant and bright;
They light up the eyes and bring us new sight.
The fear of the Lord is enduring and pure.
His laws and decrees are eternally right!

Most precious are they, more precious than gold,
And sweeter by far than sweet honeycomb.
By them is Your servant warned, and he is told,
“Rewards shall be yours in your heavenly home.”

O who can discern his errors and ways?
Forgive all my faults when from You I stray.
And keep me from willful, habitual sin;
Then I will be blameless of great transgression.

May words of my mouth and thoughts of my heart
be pleasing to You and clean in Your sight.
O Lord, You’re my Rock in the day and the night,
And my true Redeemer in whom I delight.

title: Psalm 20
lyrics:
O may the Lord give heed to you when troubled days are nigh;
And may the name of Jacob’s God protect you from on high.

May He send help to you from His own sanctuary true;
From Zion, His own holy hill, may He give strength to you.

May He recall your sacrifice; your off’rings may He heed.Selah
May He give you your heart’s desire; make all your plans succeed.

And we will sing for joy in your salvation’s victory.
We’ll lift our banners in God’s Name; May Yahweh grant your plea.

The Lord saves His anointed one, and from His holy heav’n,
I know He answers him with pow’r that His right hand has giv’n.

Some put their trust in char-i-ots; on horses some rely;
But we trust in God’s name alone, the Lord our God on high.

They’re brought down to their knees but we have risen and stand tall.
O Lord, hear us and save the king! Give answer when we call!

title: Psalm 21
lyrics:
O Lord, the king rejoices in Your strength by which he lives.
How great the joy that he does take in vic-to-ries You give.
You’ve granted him his heart’s desire; requests his lips have said;Selah
You welcomed him with blessings and gold crown upon his head.

He asked for life—You gave to him forever length of days.
You gave him vict’ries, glory great, and majesty and praise.
You’ve granted him eternal joy, and You have made him glad
with all the joy Your presence gives; great blessing he has had!

The king trusts in the Lord; and through the love of the Most High,
he’ll not be shaken, for he knows that steadfast love is nigh.
Your hand will seize your enemies; your right hand seize your foes;
When you appear, they will be like a furnace fire of woes.

The Lord will swallow them in wrath; His fire consume them all.
Their offspring you will all destroy; descendants one and all.
Though they plot evil against you, devising wicked schemes;
They can’t succeed, for all they plot will vanish like vain dreams.

For you will make them turn their backs, all those who are your foes;
And you will aim right at their face with arrows and drawn bow.
O be exalted in Your strength, O Lord of truth and light;
And we will sing and praise Your name; rejoice in Your great might.

title: Psalm 22
Psalm 23
Psalm 23
Psalm 24
lyrics:
The earth is the Lord’s, and all it contains,
The world and all those within its domains.
He founded it upon the seas by His hand;
Established it firm on the waters to stand.

O, who may ascend the hill of the Lord?
Or stand in the holy place of our God?
The one with clean hands and pure heart without stain,
Who lifts not his soul to an idol in vain.

The one who won’t swear with falsehood and lies
will blessing receive from the Lord on high.
He’ll be vindicated by his Savior God—
Such are those who seek for Your face, Jacob’s God.Selah

O lift up your heads, you doors and you gates;
To enter, the King of glory awaits.
This great King of glory, O who can He be?
The Lord, strong and mighty in battle is He!

O lift up your heads, you doors and you gates;
To enter, the King of glory awaits.
This great King of glory, O who can He be?
The Almighty Lord, King of glory is He!Selah

title: Psalm 25
lyrics:
As unto You I lift my soul, O Lord, I trust in Thee;
But let me not be put to shame, nor foes gloat over me.

Certain it is that none are shamed whose hope is in Your name;
Deeds of those who are treacherous shall all be put to shame.

Ever I want to know Your ways; teach me Your paths, O Lord.
For You I wait the whole day long—You are my Savior God.

Guide me and teach me in Your truth; recall Your mercy, Lord—
How from of old Your steadfast love has been my sole reward.

I know transgressions of my youth are ever known to Thee;
Judge not my sins; recall them not; in love, remember me.

Kind, good, and upright is the Lord; He teaches those astray;
Leading the humble in what’s right, and teaching them His way.

Moreover, all of the Lord’s ways are faithfulness and love;
Neglecting not all those who keep His cov’nant from above.

O Lord, for Your name’s sake and grace, have mercy all my years;
Pardon my guilt, for it is great. Who is the one who fears?

Quick is the Lord to know the one who fears and longs to know.
Regarding him, He will instruct the way that he should go.

Souls thus instructed by the Lord will know prosperity;
Their offspring shall receive the land, a heritage from Thee.

The friendship of the Lord is giv’n to those who fear Him still;
Unto them He makes known His law, His covenant and will.

My eyes are ever toward the Lord who plucks me from the net.
Vexed though I am, Lord, turn to me; be gracious to me yet.

When I’m afflicted and alone with troubles of the heart,
Bring me out of distress, O Lord; forgiveness do impart.

eXulting foes all gather ’round; they hate me with great hate.
Lord, guard my life and rescue me! Let shame not be my fate.

You are my refuge and my hope; let justice preserve me.
Zion has troubles—God redeem! Our hope is all in Thee.

title: Psalm 26
lyrics:
Lord, vindicate me, for I’ve walked in my integrity,
I have not wavered from Your path – I’ve trusted, Lord, in Thee.

Examine me, and try me, Lord; test heart and mind for fault;
For Your love’s ever before me; in Your truth I do walk.

I don’t sit with deceitful men, nor plot with hypocrites.
I hate the evil gatherings; with wicked will not sit.

I wash my hands in innocence before Your altar, Lord.
I tell aloud Your praise and all Your wondrous deeds record.

I love the house where You live, Lord—Your glory dwells within.
Don’t take my soul away with those bloodthirsty ones who sin.

For in their hands are wicked schemes—bribes are in their right hand;
But I walk in integrity – on level ground I stand.

Redeem me and be merciful; to me Your grace accord.
And in the great assembly I will praise and bless the Lord.

title: Psalm 27
lyrics:
The Lord’s my light and salvation—of whom, then, shall I be afraid?
The Lord’s the stronghold of my life; whom shall I fear when on Him stayed?
When evildoers come to me, who would my flesh and life devour;
When enemies and foes attack, they fall and stumble in that hour.

Though hosts besiege me round about, my heart won’t fear, but rest content;
Though war against me does break out, e’en then I will be confident.
One thing I ask and I will seek—dwell in the Lord’s house all my days,
To see the beauty of the Lord, and seek Him in His temple’s praise.

For in the day of trouble, He will keep me safe by His own hand.
He’ll hide me in His sheltered tent, and set me on a rock to stand.
My head will then be lifted up above my enemies around,
And I will offer sacrifice with songs of praise and joyful sound.

O hear my voice, Lord, when I call; be merciful and answer me;
You asked my heart to seek Your face—Your face, O Lord, I’ll surely seek.
But do not hide Your face from me; in anger, don’t turn me away;
For You have always been my help, my God and Savior, hope and stay.

The Lord receives me even if my father turns his face away.
My mother, too—though they forsake, the Lord will be my strength and stay.
Teach me Your way, and lead me, Lord, in level paths, safe from my foes.
Do not deliver me to them who vio-lent-ly with lies oppose.

For I am confident of this—I’ll see the goodness of the Lord;
Within the land of living ones, I’ll see the goodness of the Lord!
Wait for the Lord! Be strong, take heart; with courage wait upon the Lord!
Take heart, be strong, and wait for Him; with confidence, wait for the Lord!

title: Psalm 28
lyrics:
To You I call, O Lord my Rock; don’t turn Your ear from me;
For if You’re silent, then like those within the pit I’ll be.
O, hear my cry for mercy, as to You for help I call;
As I lift up my hands to the Most Holy Place of all.

Don’t drag me off with wicked ones who evil do impart,
Who speak peace with their neighbors but hide malice in their heart.
Repay them for their evil work, for deeds their hands have done;
Bring back on them what they deserve, the evil of each one.

Since they do not regard the Lord, nor works His hands have done,
He’ll tear them down, and never build back up a single one.
Praise to the Lord, for He has heard my cry for grace from Him.
The Lord’s my strength and shield; I’m helped as my heart trusts in Him.

My heart does leap for joy, and I give thanks to Him in song.
The Lord’s His people’s strength, and His anointed’s fortress strong.
O save Your people, save and bless Your own inheritance;
And be their shepherd, carry them—forever their defense.

title: Psalm 29
Psalm 30
lyrics:
I will exalt You, Lord, my God, for You have lifted me
out of the depths and did not let my foes gloat over me.
O Lord my God, I cried to You for help, and healing came;
You brought me up from grave and pit, and spared me from great shame.

Sing to the Lord, you saints of His, and praise His holy Name;
His anger lasts a moment, but His favor will remain.
For weeping may remain all night, and heavy sorrow borne;
But with the dawn returns the light; rejoicing comes with morn.

When I felt safe, I boldly said, “I’ll never shaken be!”
O Lord, You made my hill stand firm, when You showed grace to me.
But when You hid Your face from me, I surely was dismayed.
To You I called, Lord – to the Lord my cry for mercy made:

“What gain is there if I’m destroyed and go down to the pit?
Will dust praise You? Will faithfulness of God be told by it?
Hear me, O Lord, and be my help! Be merciful to me!
O Lord my God, I cry to You—my helper please now be!”

You turned my mourning into dance; my feet with dance employed.
My sackcloth You removed and then You clothed me with great joy,
That my heart may sing praise to You, and never silent be.
O Lord my God, I’ll give You thanks and praise eternally!

title: Psalm 31
Psalm 32
Psalm 33
lyrics:
Sing unto the Lord with joy, all of you righteous;
It’s fitting for all of the upright to praise.
With harp and with ly-re, make music before Him;
Sing new songs, play skillfully, joyous shouts raise.
The word of the Lord is both righteous and true, and
the Lord’s ever faithful in all that He does.
The Lord loves pure justice and righteousness ever;
The earth overflows with His unfailing love.

The Lord by His word made the heavens above us;
Their starry host came by the breath of His mouth.
He gathers the waters of seas into jars, and
He puts the deep oceans into His storehouse.
Let all the earth fear Him; let people revere Him;
He spoke and creation all came forth to be.
The Lord foils the plans of the peoples and nations,
But His plans and purpose firm ever will be.

How bless’d is the nation whose God is the Lord, and
the people He chose for His own heritage.
From heaven, He looks down and sees all the people;
From where the Lord dwells, He sees all on the earth.
He forms all their hearts, and sees all that they do, and
no king can be saved by his army or might.
A horse is a vain hope, for it can’t deliver;
Despite its great strength, it can’t save from your plight.

The eyes of the Lord are on all those who fear Him,
Upon those who hope in His unfailing love.
Our hope is in Him who alone can deliver
from death, and keep life when the famine does come.
We wait for the Lord who’s our help and our shield, and
in Him we rejoice as we trust in His name.
O Lord, may Your unfailing love rest upon us,
As we place our hope in You—always the same.

title: Psalm 34
lyrics:
All of my days I’ll bless and praise the Lord;
His praise will ever be within my mouth.
Boast, O my soul, extol the living Lord;
Let all the humble hear it and be glad.

Come, join with me to magnify the Lord.
Let us together praise His name on high!
Daily I sought; the Lord has answered me,
And He from all my terrors set me free.

Each one who looks to Him is not ashamed.
For this poor man called; the Lord heard and saved.
God’s righteous angel constantly encamps
around those fearing God and rescues them.

How good to taste the goodness of the Lord;
Bless’d is the man who trusts in Him alone.
In fear of God, you saints, forever dwell;
For those who fear God never suffer want.

Join not the lions hungering for food,
But trust the Lord instead, and have no want.
Know, children, come and listen unto me,
And I will teach you how to fear the Lord.

Love you long life and want to see good days?
May your tongue keep from evil and all lies!
Now from all evil flee—instead do good;
Seek peace and strive for it with heart and mind.

Open are His eyes toward the righteous ones;
God‘s ears attentive to their ev’ry cry.
Proud, evil men, the Lord‘s face does oppose;
Quickly He cuts their mem’ry from the earth.

Righteous cry out—the Lord will hear their cry;
Saves them from all their troubles and distress.
The Lord is close to every broken heart,
And saves those who are crushed in heaviness.

Under His care, the righteous still have trials;
Very sure is the Lord’s deliverance.
Well He protects their bones and does assure
not one of them will ever broken be.

eXpect that evil will slay wicked ones;
Yes, foes of righteous ones will be condemned.
Zion’s true servants, the Lord does redeem;
None who take refuge in Him stand condemned.

title: Psalm 35
lyrics:
Contend, O Lord, with those who do contend with me;
And fight against all those who fight against me constantly.
Take up Your shield and spear; arise, come to my aid;
Stop those who chase me; Say to me, “I am your salvation.”

May those who seek my life now be disgraced and shamed.
May those who plot my ruin, Lord, be turned back and dismayed.
Like chaff before the wind, may angels drive them on;
May their path dark and slipp’ry be—God‘s angel driving on.

Because they hid their net, dug pits without a cause,
May nets they hid entangle them; in their pits let them fall.
Then my soul will rejoice in the Lord’s salvation,
My bones will say, “Who’s like You, Lord? You save the poor from them.”

The ruthless testify; pose questions filled with scorn;
They repay evil for my good and leave my soul forlorn.
And yet when they were ill, I fasted and I prayed;
I mourned as for my friend in grief, tears as for family made.

But when I fell, they came, attacked with sland’rous glee;
Like wicked, they with malice mocked, and gnashed their teeth at me.
How long will You look on? O Lord, come rescue me!
And save my life from ravages of lions who stalk me.

Then, I will give You thanks; Your praises I will sing,
And in the congregation great, exalting praise I’ll bring.
Don’t let my foes rejoice, who hate me without cause;
Don’t let them gloat and wink their eye with malice, without cause.

They do not speak in peace, but plan their wicked lies;
Against the peaceful, they say, “Ha! We’ve seen with our own eyes!”
But You, O Lord, have seen; don’t be far off, O Lord.
Awake and rise to my defense; contend for me, my God.

Lord, in Your righteousness, don’t let them gloat o’er me;
Don’t let them think, “Aha, we won! We’ve conquered him wholly.”
May those who gloat o’er me and the distress I face,
Who lift themselves o’er me be clothed with shame and with disgrace.

May all who take delight that vindication’s mine;
May they with joy and gladness shout, and say, “The glory’s Thine!
The Lord delights as those, His servants, are made strong.”
My tongue will sing Your righteousness and praises all day long.

title: Psalm 36
Psalm 37
lyrics:
Don’t fret because of evil men—of wicked ones, don’t envious be;
For they, like grass, will fade away; like plants they’ll wilt and die quickly.
But trust the Lord and do what’s good; dwell in the land, safe days transpire.
Delight yourself in God the Lord, and He will give your heart’s desire.

Commit your way unto the Lord; put trust in Him for all you do;
“He’ll make your righteousness shine bright, your justice like the sun at noon.
Be still before the Lord and wait; don’t fret when evil ones succeed;
Refrain from anger, turn from wrath; to fret will just to evil lead.

For evil ones will be cut off, but not those who hope in the Lord;
They will the land inherit while the wicked soon will be no more.
You’ll look for them—they won’t be found, though you may search and never cease;
Instead, the meek will find great joy, inherit land and know great peace.

The wicked against righteous plot, in anger gnash their teeth at them;
The Lord just laughs, at wicked scoffs; He knows the sureness of their end.
The wicked draw the sword and bow, to bring the poor and needy down;
To slay all those whose ways are true, the upright who God’s ways have found.

The swords the wicked hold will turn, and pierce their own hearts craftily.
Their bows will all to pieces break, for God the end of all does see.
It’s better to be poor, but just, than have the wealth of wicked ways.
The pow-er of the wicked fades; the Lord the righteous will upraise.

The just ones’ days are known to Him; their heritage will long endure;
In times of crisis, they’ll not fade; in famine their food will be sure.
But wicked ones will perish and the Lord’s vast enemies will fall;
Like beauty of the fields, they’ll fade; like vanished smoke, no trace at all.

The wicked borrow—don’t repay; but righteous ones give gen’rously.
The Lord will bless with promised land; those cursed of God cut off will be.
If God delights in a man’s way, He makes his steps to firmly stand.
E’en if he stumbles, he’ll not fall; the Lord upholds him with His hand.

I once was young and now am old, but this is what I’ve never seen—
The righteous ones forsaken, or their children begging, poor and lean.
The righteous lend and give away, their children will be bless’d by God.
So turn from evil and do good; you’ll dwell forever with your God.

The Lord loves justice and the just; He won’t forsake those faithful pure;
They’ll be protected evermore, but wicked offspring won’t endure.
The righteous will inherit land, and dwell in it forevermore.
Their mouths speak wisdom and their tongues speak what is just and right and sure.

The law of God is in their heart; their feet don’t slip from off the way;
But wicked ones—they lie in wait to take the righteous lives away.
The Lord won’t leave them in their pow’r; and He won’t let them be condemned.
Wait for the Lord, and keep His way; He’ll lift you up to see their end.

For righteous will inherit land while wicked ones will be cut off;
And you will see it in your day—the end of all who boast and scoff.
I’ve seen the wicked, ruthless man who briefly flourished like a tree,
But soon he perished, passed away; I looked for him, but gone was he.

Consider blameless, upright ones—they have a future, full of peace,
But sinners all will be destroyed; their future cut off, soon to cease.
Salvation comes from God the Lord; in troubled times, a refuge sure.
The Lord delivers righteous ones from wicked hands, safe evermore.

title: Psalm 38
Psalm 39
Psalm 40
Psalm 41
lyrics:
How bless-ed is the one who loves the helpless and the weak;
The Lord delivers and protects that one when troubles peak.
The Lord preserves and saves his life, and blesses in the land;
He’ll not surrender him to foes, but keep him in His hand.

The Lord sustains him when he’s ill, and lifts him from his bed;
The Lord his illness takes away by lifting up his head.
I said, “O Lord, have mercy on a sinner steeped in wrong;
Heal me, I cry, for I have sinned against You all day long.”

My enemies about me say, with malice, ill intent,
“When will he die? When will his name both perish and be spent?”
For everyone speaks ill of me, and slanders in his heart,
Then they go out and spread their lies, great evil they impart.

My enemies conspire and plot, and set their traps for me.
They whisper evil plans for me as if I do not see.
They say, “A vile disease has come and struck him down to die;
His bed will be his earthly end, right where he now does lie.”

Even my friend who shared my bread, in whom I put my trust
has lifted up his heel ’gainst me and scattered me with dust.
But You, O Lord, have mercy now and raise me up, I pray,
That I may rise and turn on them and all their sins repay.

I know that You are pleased with me, for my foe is undone;
In my integrity let me into Your presence come.
Praise be to God our cov’nant Lord, the God of Is-ra-el,
Forever and forevermore. Amen, Amen we’ll tell!

title: Psalm 42
lyrics:
As the deer pants for water clear, so my soul thirsts for You;
My soul thirsts for the living God; when can I meet with You?

My tears have been my food all day, and also through the night;
While men mock me and say all day, “Where is your God of might?”

These things I do remember well, as I pour out my soul:
How I went with the multitude into the house of God.

I led the great procession with a shout of joy and song,
With thanks and praise I went among the festive, joyful throng.

Why are you so downcast, my soul? Why so disturbed in me?
Put hope in God—I’ll praise Him yet; my Savior God is He!

My soul is downcast within me, so I remember You,
From land along the Jordan, heights of Hermon, Mizar, too.

Deep calls to deep within the roar of Your great waterfalls;
Your waves and breakers swept o’er me; they flooded without pause.

By day the Lord directs His love, His steadfast love to me;
At night His song is with me still—my prayer to God will be.

I say to God my Rock, “O why have You forgotten me?
Why must I mourn all day oppressed by the vile enemy?”

My bones do suffer mortal pain; my foes taunt me all day.
“Where is your God?” they mock with scorn, “Where is your God?” they say.

Why are you so downcast, my soul? Why so disturbed in me?
Put hope in God—I’ll praise Him yet; my Savior God is He!

title: Psalm 43
lyrics:
O vindicate and plead my cause, O God, against my foe;
Come rescue me from wicked men, a nation vile and low.

You are my stronghold and my God; why do You reject me?
Why must I mourn all day oppressed by the vile enemy?

Send forth Your light and send Your truth, and let them guide me well.
O let them bring me to Your mount, the place where You do dwell.

Then I’ll go to God’s altar—God, my joy and my delight;
And I will praise You with the harp, O God, my God and light.

Why are you so downcast, my soul? Why so disturbed in me?
Put hope in God—I’ll praise Him yet; my Savior God is He!

title: Psalm 44
lyrics:
O God, we have heard what our fathers have told,
What You did in their days, days glorious of old.
With Your hand You drove out the nations and gave
our fathers their land; crushed all foes in the grave.

It was not by sword that they took all the land,
Their arm brought no vict’ry—it was by Your hand;
Your right hand, Your arm, and the light of Your face;
You loved them so truly, and showed them Your grace.

For You are my God, and You are my great King;
And vict’ries for Jacob You plan and You bring.
Through You all our enemies we can depose;
Through Your name we trample on all of our foes.

I trust not my bow or my sword for my fame,
For You give the vict’ry; put our foes to shame.
In God we will boast throughout all the day long;
We’ll give praise to Your name forever in song.Selah

But now You’ve rejected and humbled us too;
You no longer go out when our armies do.
You made us retreat, as the enemy closed,
And we have been plundered by vi-o-lent foes.

You’ve given us up; we’re devoured like sheep;
You’ve scattered us; among the nations we weep.
You sold us, Your people, and nothing did gain;
You gave up Your people for others to reign.

We’re now a reproach to our neighbors and friends;
The scorn and derision of them never ends.
You’ve made us a byword among nations all;
They shake their heads at us, and mockingly call.

Disgrace is before me throughout all the day;
My face must be covered; shame won’t go away.
They taunt and revile me; reproach never ends,
Because of my foes who are bent on revenge.

Now all this has happened, though we had been true;
We broke not Your cov’nant; did not forget You.
Our hearts had not turned back; our feet had not strayed;
You crushed us in darkness; a jackal’s haunt made.

If we had forgotten the name of our God,
Or spread out our hands to a false, foreign god—
Would God not have seen it, since He knows our heart?
For Your sake we face death, like sheep torn apart.

Awake, Lord! Why sleep? Don’t reject us again.
Why hide Your face, forgetting our oppression?
We’re brought down to dust, our life’s flung to the ground.
Rise up now and help us! Let Your love abound!

title: Psalm 45
lyrics:
My heart is stirred by a grand, noble theme,
As I recite my verses for the king.
My tongue is like a skillful writer’s pen,
As it stands ready to recite and sing.

You are most excellent of men e’er sung;
Since God bless’d you, your lips are full of grace.
Gird your sword on your side, O mighty one;
Be clothed with majesty; splendor embrace.

In majesty, ride forth in victory;
Let your right hand display your awesome deeds.
With righteousness, truth and humility,
Ride forth in majesty victoriously.

Your arrows sharply pierce all foes of yours,
and all the nations fall beneath your feet.
Your throne, O God, will last forevermore;
Justice will be the scepter that You keep.

You love true righteousness, and evil hate,
So God, your God has set you over men.
He has anointed you in splendor great,
And with the oil of joy above all them.

All of your robes are fragrant with the smell
of myrrh and cinnamon and aloes, too.
From palaces adorned with ivory well,
Music of strings brings gladsome joy to you.

Daughters of kings are with your women here;
At your right hand, your bride in Ophir gold.
Listen, O daughter, ponder and give ear:
Forget your people and your whole household.

The king’s enthralled by beauty that you bear,
So honor him, for he’s your lord indeed.
Tyre’s daughter comes with gifts for you most fair,
And men of wealth will come, your grace to seek.

All glo-rious is the princess in her room;
Her gown is woven with the finest gold.
Led to the king, in beauty she’ll come soon,
With her companions, he will her behold.

They’re led with joy and gladness to the king,
Brought in procession to his palace grand.
In place of fathers, you their sons will bring;
You’ll make them princes all throughout the land.

I’ll cause your name to last in memory,
All generations will remember sure.
Nations will therefore, praise you joyfully,
Always, forever, and forevermore.

title: Psalm 46
lyrics:
God is our refuge and our strength,
In Him our hope is found;
An ever-present help in need,
When trouble is around.

Therefore, we will not fear, though earth
should tremble and give way;
Though mountains fall into the sea,
He’s still our help and stay;

Though waters roar and foam with pow’r,
And tempests make us shake;
Though surging waters even cause
the mountain peaks to quake.Selah

There is a river that makes glad
the city of our God;
The holy place where the Most High
does dwell and reign abroad.

God is within her; she stands firm
and will not fall away;
And God will surely give her help
when comes the break of day.

All nations are in uproar as
their kingdoms rise and fall;
He lifts His voice, and all earth melts
before His mighty call.

The Lord Almighty is with us,
He is our refuge sure.
The God of Jacob is our trust,
Our fortress evermore.Selah

Come, see the works the Lord has done,
The desolations here.
He makes wars cease to ends of earth,
And breaks the bow and spear.

“Be still, and know that I am God,
Exalted I will be!
Among all nations, all the earth,
Exalted I will be!”

The Lord Almighty is with us,
He is our refuge sure;
The God of Jacob is our trust,
Our fortress evermore.

title: Psalm 47
lyrics:
O clap your hands, you nations all, and shout with joyful mirth!
How awesome is the Lord Most High, great King o’er all the earth!
He brought down nations under us, and peoples ’neath our feet.
He chose inheritance for us; His love did Jacob meet.Selah

God has ascended with a shout—the Lord with trumpet sound.
Sing praise to God, sing to our King; sing praises long and loud.
For God is King of all the earth—sing with a psalm of praise.
God reigns o’er nations; He sits on His holy throne always.

The nobles of the people come, they gather in the land,
Assembling as the people of the God of Abraham.
For all the kings of all the earth belong to God alone,
He is exalted greatly as He reigns upon His throne!

title: Psalm 48
lyrics:
O great is the Lord; most worthy of praise
on His holy mount, in His city praised.
Its beauty in loftiness, joy of the earth—
Mount Zion, the city whose King gives it worth.

For God is in her, He shows Himself strong.
When kings joined their ranks, advancing along,
They saw her, astounded—in terror they fled,
For trembling had seized them like labor pain dread.

You smote them like ships of Tarshish destroyed,
Which, shattered by wind, could not be deployed.
As we’ve heard, so we’ve seen, the city of God,
She is made secure by the Almighty Lord.Selah

When we come into Your temple, O God,
We meditate on Your unfailing love.
Like Your name, O God, Your praise through earth resounds;
Your right hand with righteousness greatly abounds.

Mount Zion does sing, the villages too—
They’re glad because all Your judgments are true.
Go walk around Zion, her citadels count;
Go ’round her and wonder at God’s holy mount.

Consider most well her ramparts and tow’rs,
So that you may tell your children her pow’r.
For this God’s our God, and forever will be,
Our guide unto death, ever faithful is He!

title: Psalm 49
lyrics:
Hear this, all you people, listen; all who in this world do live;
High and low, both rich and poor, now listen to the words I give.
My mouth will speak words of wisdom; understanding from my heart.
My ear’s tuned to hear a proverb, myst’ries I will now impart:

Why should I give way to fear when evil days and foes surround—
Those who trust in their great wealth, and boast of riches all around?
No man can redeem another or to God a ransom give;
Ransom for a life is costly; no amount can make him live.

Wise men and the foolish both die—leave their wealth to others’ hands;
Tombs remain their house forever, though they had obtained great lands.
Men, despite their riches, perish; they are like the beasts that die.
This will be the fate of those who trust themselves and follow lies.Selah

Like sheep, they go to the grave, and death will feed upon them there;
Upright ones will then rule o’er them; they’ll decay as the grave’s share.
They’ll lie far from earthly dwellings; but God will redeem my life;
From the grave He’ll surely take me to Himself and end all strife.Selah

Don’t be awed when men grow rich, and their vast splendor does increase,
For they will take nothing with them—when they die their wealth will cease.
Though they count themselves as bless-ed, they’ll join those who see no life.
Those with riches without wisdom will be like the beasts that die.

title: Psalm 50
lyrics:
The Mighty One, true God, the Lord, speaks to the earth around;
He summons all from rising sun to where the sun goes down.

From Zion, beautiful and pure, God shines in every age.
Our God comes and won’t silent be—fire, tempest ’round Him rage.

He summons heav’n above and earth that He might judge with right:
“Come, gather those who cov’nant made with Me by sacrifice.”

The heav’ns proclaim His righteousness; He is the judge alone.
And this is what the Lord does speak to those who are His own:Selah

“Hear, O My people, I will speak, against you testify;
I am your God; I don’t rebuke your constant sacrifice.

“But I’ve no need of bulls or goats with which your folds are filled;
For I own every animal—cows on a thousand hills.

“I know each bird in mountains high, all creatures of the field.
I hunger not—the world is Mine, and all that it does yield.

“Do I eat flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats you bring?
The sacrifice you make to God must be a thank off’ring.

“Fulfill your vows to the Most High, and call when you have need.
I will deliver you, and you will honor Me indeed.”

But to the wicked in His flock the righteous God says this:
“What right have you to tout My laws; take cov’nant on your lips?

“For you hate My instruction, and you cast My words aside.
You join with thieves and also with adulterers abide.

“You use your mouth for evil, and your tongue for vile deceit.
You speak against your brother, and against him slander speak.

“These things you’ve done and I kept mute—you thought I was like you!
But I’ll rebuke you to your face; I will your wrong accuse!

“Consider this, who forget God, or I will bring you down;
To pieces you’ll be torn with none to rescue you around.

“The one who sacrifices true, with thanks does honor Me;
And he prepares the way so God’s salvation he may see.”

title: Psalm 51
lyrics:
In Your unfailing love, O God,
Have mercy upon me;
Blot out transgressions, cleanse from sin,
Purge my iniquity.

For my transgressions and my sin
are always in Your sight;
’Gainst You alone, I’ve evil done,
And turned from what is right.

So You are right when You do speak
and judge—without, within;
For from the time I was conceived,
I have been trapped in sin.

For truth is what You call us to,
Formed in our inward parts;
You teach me wisdom day by day,
In the depths of my heart.

Cleanse me with hyssop, make me clean;
Wash me—I’ll be as snow.
Let me hear joy, let bones rejoice
which You once crushed below.

Now hide Your face from all my sins,
Blot out iniquity.
Create in me a pure heart, God,
Renew Your life in me.

Renew a steadfast spirit, God,
And cast me not from You.
Don’t take Your Holy Spirit, Lord,
from me—Your Spirit true.

Restore to me salvation’s joy
and grant, O Lord, to me,
A willing spirit to keep me
and then sustained I’ll be.

Then I’ll teach sinners of Your ways
and they will turn to You.
Save me from bloodguilt, Savior God,
My tongue will sing Your truth.

Lord, open up my lips, my mouth
will Your great praise declare.
You don’t delight in sacrifice,
Or I would bring it there.

The sacrifices You require
are broken, contrite hearts;
O God, You won’t despise these if
They’re from our inward parts.

With pleasure, prosper Zion, and
build up Jerusalem;
Then righteous off’rings will be made
and You’ll delight in them.

title: Psalm 52
lyrics:
Why do you boast, you mighty man, in evil and in wrong?
The steadfast love of God endures all day both deep and strong.

Your tongue plots great destruction—like a razor, it cuts deep.
And you love evil more than good; trade truth for your deceit.Selah

You love each harmful word, O you deceitful, wicked tongue!
So God will surely bring you down when your false words are done.

He’ll snatch you up and tear you from your tent when ruin comes;
He also will uproot you from the land of living ones.Selah

The righteous ones will see and fear; they’ll laugh at him and say,
“Here is the man who would not make the Lord his strength and stay.

“His stronghold was not God; instead in wealth he put his trust;
He grew strong by destroying men and grinding them in dust.”

But I am like an olive tree in God’s house growing sure;
I trust in God’s unfailing love, and will forevermore.

Forever I will praise You, God, for all that You have done;
Your name is good—I’ll hope in You, amidst the godly ones.

title: Psalm 53
lyrics:
The fool says in his heart, “There surely is no God.”
They’re all corrupt, their ways are vile; there’s no one who does good.

From hea-ven God looks down upon the sons of men,
To see if any understand, if any seek for Him.

But all have turned away, together all have sinned;
There’s no one who does good—not one—they’re all corrupt within.

O will they never learn, the evildoers all,
Who eat my people as their bread, and on God do not call?

For there they are, in dread, when nothing’s there to dread;
God scattered bones of those ’gainst you, put them to shame instead.

Would that Isr’el be saved! From Zion, God restores
His people—Jacob, Is-ra-el, be glad forevermore!

title: Psalm 54
lyrics:
Save me, O God, by Your great name,
In might, defend my cause.
O hear my prayer, and listen, God,
My mouth upon You calls.

For strangers are attacking me,
The ruthless seek my life;
The ones with no regard for God—
They fill my days with strife.Selah

God surely is my help, He is
the Lord who strengthens me;
In faithfulness, destroy those who
with evil slander me.

And I will offer unto You
a sacrifice most free;
I’ll praise Your name, for it is good,
O Lord, You rescue me.

For He has saved me from distress,
From all my troubled woes;
My eyes have looked in triumph on
the ruin of my foes.

title: Psalm 55
lyrics:
Listen to my prayer, O God,
And do not ignore my plea.
Hear and answer, for my thoughts
do dismay and trouble me,
At the voice of enemies,
At the stares of wicked ones;
They bring suff’ring down on me,
Their sharp taunts are never done.

My heart is in anguish sore,
Death’s great terrors assail me.
Fear and trembling plague me more,
Horror has o’ertaken me.
I said, “Oh, that I could fly
far away and be at rest!
I would flee far as the sky,Selah
Shelter far from storm’s tempest.”

Lord, confuse them and confound
words they speak and deeds they do;
Violent strife is all around,
In the city through and through.
Day and night they prowl about
on its walls and all within;
They destroy and loot and rout,
Streets are filled with lies and sin.

If a foe or enemy
insults me, I’ll take from him
anything he says ’gainst me;
I could hide myself from him.
But it’s you, my closest friend—
You with whom I walked abroad,
Had sweet friendship without end,
Even in the house of God.

Let death take my enemies
by surprise, their life grow dim;
Let the grave their life now seize—
Evil finds its home with them.
But I call to God alone;
The Lord saves me in distress.
Evening, morning, and at noon,
I cry out—He hears, gives rest.

He will ransom me unharmed
from the battle waged ’gainst me;
Though I was opposed, alarmed;
Though my foes were vast, many.
God, who is enthroned always,
Will afflict them with His rod;Selah
For they never change their ways
and they have no fear of God.

My companion sacks his friends,
Violates his covenant;
His attacking never ends,
Evil from his heart is sent.
Speech is smooth as butter sweet,
But his heart is only war;
Words are soothing he repeats,
But they carry a drawn sword.

Cast your cares upon the Lord;
He’ll sustain you when you call.
He will ever keep His word;
Never let the righteous fall.
But God, You will act always
to bring wicked ones their due;
They won’t live out half their days,
As for me, I trust in You.

title: Psalm 56
Psalm 57
Psalm 58
Psalm 59
lyrics:
Deliver me from those, O God, who are my enemies;
Protect me from all those who do rise up to threaten me.
Deliver me from wicked ones and evil-doing men,
And save me from the wickedness of those bloodthirsty men.

See how they lie in wait for me! They fiercely do combine
against me, Lord; they do conspire for no offense of mine.
I’ve done no wrong, yet they in wait are ready to seize me.
Arise to help and meet with me, look on my plight and see!

Awake, Almighty Lord of hosts, O God of Is-ra-el,
Arouse Yourself to punish all the traitors who rebel.Selah
At ev’ning they go to and fro; they make great noise and sound;
They snarl like dogs and prowl about the city all around.

See what they spew out from their mouths, for in their lips are swords;
And they say, “Who can possibly hear any of our words?”
But You, O Lord, will laugh at them, You at the nations scoff;
My strength, I’ll watch and wait for You, my fortress and my rock.

My God will meet me in His love; He’ll let me gloat and see
the end of all those wicked ones, who mock and slander me.
But do not kill them, Lord, our shield, or people will forget;
By Your strong power, bring them down, and make them wander yet.

And for the sins which their mouths speak, the words their lips let fly,
Let them be caught in their own pride, because they curse and lie.
Consume them in Your wrath, O Lord; consume till they’re no more.
It will be known to ends of earth that Jacob’s God is Lord.Selah

At ev’ning they go to and fro; they make great noise and sound;
They snarl like dogs, and prowl about the city all around.
They wander, searching for their food and if not satisfied,
They howl like dogs and prowl around, and don’t care how they’ve lied.

But I’ll sing of Your strength, O God; at dawn Your love I’ll praise;
For You’re my fortress, refuge, and my tow’r in troubled days.
O God, You are my strength, and I sing praises unto You;
O God, You are my fortress, full of lovingkindness true.

title: Psalm 60
lyrics:
O God, You have rejected us, and scattered us abroad.
You have been very angry but return to us, O God.

For You have made the earth to quake, and torn it open wide;
Now heal its fractures, for it shakes and cannot long abide.

You’ve shown Your people desperate times, and hardship on them sent;
And You have made us drink the wine of staggering lament.

And yet a banner You have giv’n to those who do fear You;
That it may be displayed abroad, and witness to Your truth.Selah

Save us and help with Your right hand; O hear and answer me,
That those You love may come to be delivered and set free.

God spoke from His most holy place, “In triumph I will move;
I’ll parcel out both Shechem and the Valley of Succoth.

“Now Gilead is Mine by right; Manasseh Mine shall be;
My helmet’s E-phra-im, and Judah will my scepter be.”

“Moab’s My washbowl, and My shoe on Edom I will throw;
I’ll shout over Philistia; in triumph I will go.”

Who will bring me in strength up to the city fortified?
And who will be the one that can to Edom lead and guide?

Is it not You, O God, who did reject and spurn us so?
Will You not now return, O God, forth with our armies go?

O give us help against the foe, for human help is vain.
Through God we’ll gain the victory; He’ll tread our foes again.

title: Psalm 61
lyrics:
Hear my pleading cry, O God, and listen to my prayer below.
From the ends of earth I call You, as my heart grows faint and low;
Lead me to the rock that’s higher, higher than I e’er could go.
You have been my constant refuge, a strong tow-er ‘gainst the foe.

How I long to dwell with You, God, in Your tent forevermore,
And take refuge in the shelter of Your wings amidst the storm.Selah
For You’ve heard the vows I’ve made, God, and You’ve given unto me
the inheritance of all who fear Your name so faithfully.

Now increase the days the king lives; generations his years be.
May he be enthroned forever, in God’s presence gloriously.
Send Your love and faithful mercy to protect him all his days;
Then I will fulfill my vows and to Your name ever sing praise.

title: Psalm 62
lyrics:
My soul finds rest in God alone; salvation comes from Him.
My soul in silence waits for God; I only look to Him.

He only is my fortress, rock, and my salvation sure;
I’ll not be shaken, for He is my stronghold evermore.

How long will you assail a man? Would all you throw him down—
And treat him like a leaning wall, or fence that’s tottering ’round?

They plot for ill to thrust him down from his high place or worse;
They joy in lies—with their mouths bless, but in their hearts they curse.Selah

Find rest, my soul, in God alone, for my hope comes from Him.
In silence wait for God, my soul; and only look to Him.

He only is my fortress, rock, and my salvation sure;
I’ll not be shaken, for He is my stronghold evermore.

For my salvation, honor too, depend on God alone.
He is my mighty rock of strength, my refuge—He alone.

O people, trust in Him always; at all times, all day long;
Pour out your hearts before Him for God is our refuge strong.Selah

For lowborn men are but a breath, and highborn men a lie;
When on the balance they are weighed, they’re only a breath’s sigh.

Trust not in greed, oppression, nor put hope in robbery;
If wealth increase, don’t set your heart upon its vanity.

One thing God spoke, two things I’ve heard: that You, O God, are strong,
And loving, too, Lord—You reward each one as they have done.

title: Psalm 63
lyrics:
O God, You are my God, and I
will seek You earnestly.
My soul does thirst, my body longs;
With You I want to be.

I’m in a dry and weary land,
Where water can’t be found;
But I have seen You in Your house
with glory all around.

Your love is better far than life;
Your name I’ll glorify.
I’ll praise You long as I may live,
And lift my hands on high.

My soul will be well satisfied
as with the best of food;
My mouth will sing, my lips will praise,
With praise that You are due.

Upon my bed, I think of You,
Through watches of the night;
In shadow of Your wings, I sing,
For You’re my help and light.

Your right hand does uphold me, and
my soul does cling to You;
And those who seek my life will be
destroyed where none can view.

They will be given to the sword,
For jackals, they’ll be food.
The king finds joy; God’s people praise;
While liars are subdued.

title: Psalm 64
Psalm 65
lyrics:
Silence and praise wait for You, O my God;
Waiting in Zion where the vows are paid.
O, God who hears the prayers we offer up,
To You all flesh will come and seek Your aid.

When we were overwhelmed by sin and shame,
All our transgressions You did cover o’er.
Bless’d is the one You choose and do bring near.
We will be filled with good within Your courts.

You answer us with deeds of righteousness;
O God our Savior, we look unto Thee.
You are the hope of all who look to You,
From ends of earth and to the farthest sea.

You formed the mountains by Your pow’r and might;
You, Lord, are armed with strength from age to age.
You still the roaring of the seas and waves,
And still the tumult of the nations’ rage.

All those who dwell on earth’s remotest shore,
Who, at earth’s end their living do employ;
They stand in awe of all Your wonders great—
You make the dawn and sunset shout for joy.

You visit earth, and it does overflow;
You do enrich all life by Your own hand.
Streams You provide for waters forth to flow;
Grain for the harvest over all the land.

You drench with water furrows of the earth,
Settle its ridges, soften them with rain.
You bless earth’s growth—Your paths with life o’erflow;
You crown the year with bounty once again.

The pastures of the wilderness break forth;
Hills gird themselves with joy abundantly.
Meadows are clothed with flocks and fields with grain;
They shout for joy and sing triumphantly.

title: Psalm 66
lyrics:
O shout with great joy unto God, all the earth!
And sing out the praise of His glory and worth!
Proclaim unto God, “O how awesome Your deeds!
Your pow’r makes Your enemies cringe before Thee!

“All those on the earth bow down, praising Your name.
They sing praise to You, they sing unto Your name.”Selah
Come, see all the works that the Lord God has done;
How awesome His works which for man He has done!

Come, let us rejoice—He turned sea into land;
They passed through the waters, on foot they could stand.
Forever He rules by His power and might;
His eyes watch the nations—they’re all in His sight.Selah

Don’t let the rebellious against Him arise;
Bless our God, O peoples, let praise fill the skies.
For He has preserved us, and kept our feet sure;
For You, God, did test us, like silver most pure.

You put us in prison, bound us in the net;
Laid burdens upon us, oppressing us yet.
You let men ride o’er us; great fire we went through;
Through fire and through water, but You brought us through.

I’ll come to Your temple with burnt offering;
My vows I’ll fulfill; sacrifices I’ll bring.
For vows that my lips made when trouble did brew,
I’ll sacrifice rams, bulls, and goats unto You.Selah

Come, listen, all you who fear God earnestly,
And let me proclaim what He has done for me.
I cried out to Him with my mouth and my voice,
My tongue spoke His praise and my spirit rejoiced.

Now if I had cherished my sin in my heart,
The Lord would not listen, nor answer impart.
But God surely listened and He heard my voice.
His love’s ever with me—Bless God and rejoice!

title: Psalm 67
lyrics:
May God be gracious to us, and bless us from above,
Make His face shine upon us, with all His cov’nant love;Selah
So that Your ways, O God, may be known in all the earth,
And Your salvation known by all peoples of the earth.

May all the peoples praise You, O God, may peoples praise;
May all the nations sing and be glad for all their days.
For You will rule the peoples with justice by Your hand,
And You will guide the nations in each and ev’ry land.Selah

May all the peoples praise You, may peoples praise and sing.
The earth will yield its harvest, and will its produce bring.
And God, our God will bless us; yes, God will blessing send,
And all the earth will fear Him to its remotest end.

title: Psalm 68
lyrics:
Let God arise, and scattered let His e-ne-mies all be;
And let the foes that hate Him all before His presence flee.
As smoke is blown away by wind, may You blow them away;
As fire melts wax, let wicked ones so perish and decay.

But may the righteous ones be glad: let them before God’s sight
be joyful; yes, let them rejoice in Him with all their might.
Sing praise to God, to His name sing; extol Him with your voice,
Who rides on clouds—His name’s the Lord—before Him now rejoice.

A father to the fatherless is God who sees their face;
Defender of the widow is God in His holy place.
God sets the lonely in fam’lies, frees pris’ners with His hand,
They sing; but the rebellious ones live in a sun-scorched land.

O God, when You went out before Your people in great might;
And when through desert wilderness, You marched them day and night,Selah
The earth did shake, the sky broke forth and rain from heaven fell,
Before the One of Sinai—God, the God of Israel.

You gave abundant showers, God, Your people did sustain;
You bless’d Your tired inheritance, and sent refreshing rain.
Your people settled in the land, and from Your bounty, Lord,
You filled Your people in their need, provided for the poor.

The Lord Himself announced the word, and many spoke it forth:
“Great kings and armies flee in haste, and you divide the spoils.
E’en while you sleep among the sheep, beside the fires by night;
You’re covered like a dove’s fair wings with gold and silver bright.”

When God Almighty scattered kings, it was like Zalmon’s snow.
The hills of Bashan are so great, majestic in their show.
Why gaze in envy, mountains high, at the great mountain where
God chose to reign? The Lord Himself will dwell forever there.

God’s char-i-ots ten thousand are, and many thousand more;
The Lord has come from Sinai to His sanctuary sure.
When You ascended up on high, majestic there to reign,
You led forth captives—led a host of captives in Your train.

And You received such gifts from men, e’en from those who rebel;
That You, O Lord God, even there, in their midst You might dwell.
Bless’d be the Lord, and praise to Him, who is our Savior sure,
Who daily bears our burdens and does save us evermore.Selah

For our God is a God who saves; our lives are in His hand.
And from the Sovereign Lord does come escape from death’s strong band.
But surely God will crush the head of those who are His foes—
The hairy crowns of those in whom great sin persists and grows.

The Lord says, “I will bring them forth from Bashan unto Me,
And I will bring them from the depths of e’en the farthest sea.
That in the blood of all your foes, your feet may be washed there;
And your dogs’ tongues will lick their blood—they, too, will have their share.”

Your great procession is in view, O God of majesty—
Procession of my God and King to the sanc-tu-ar-y.
In front are singers, after them musicians are arrayed;
With them are maidens who upon the tambourines do play.

Within the congregation great, praise God with one accord;
All Isr’el’s vast assembly praise and bless the mighty Lord.
The little tribe of Benjamin is leading them along,
Then Judah’s princes, Zebulun, and Naphtali’s great throng.

Call forth Your power, God, show strength, as You have done before;
To Your house at Jerusalem, kings will bring gifts, O Lord.
Rebuke the beast among the reeds, the herd of bulls among
the calves of all the nations where Your glories have been sung.

Then, humbled, may they bring to You rich bars of silver ore;
Lord, scatter all the nations who delight in waging war.
Then envoys and great kings will come from out of Egypt’s land;
Cush, too, will then submit to God, to Him stretch out her hand.

Sing praise to God, O kingdoms of the earth from all around;
Sing praises to the Lord our God, raise up a mighty sound! Selah
To Him who rides the skies above, which He of old did found,
Who thunders with a mighty voice—a mighty thund’rous sound.

Proclaim the pow-er of our God, whose majesty on high
is over all of Is-ra-el; whose pow’r is o’er the sky.
You are most awesome, mighty God, in Your sanc-tu-ar-y;
The God of Is-ra-el gives pow’r and strength—to Him praise be!

title: Psalm 69
lyrics:
Save me, O God, for waters have engulfed me like a flood.
There is no foothold as I sink in miry depths, O God.

I’ve called for help, my throat is parched, and God cannot be found.
And those who hate me without cause are more than I can count.

Yes, many are my enemies; their plot to kill is real.
And I am forced to give to them what I did never steal.

You know my folly, O my God; my guilt is in plain view.
Let me not be a cause of shame for all who hope in You.

O Lord, the Lord Almighty God, may those who seek Your face,
Not be ashamed because of me, O God of Isr’el’s race.

For Your sake I endure great scorn; my face is filled with shame.
I am a stranger to my kin, to all who share my name.

I am consumed with zeal, O Lord, for Your house fervently;
The insults of those who curse You now fall with weight on me.

And when I weep and fast, I must endure scorn constantly;
When sackcloth is my daily garb, they all make sport of me.

Those seated at the gate mock me; they taunt with drunken song;
But to You, Lord, I pray—hear me! Your love is wide and long.

In Your salvation, answer me, and save me from the mire;
Don’t let me sink—deliver me! Their hatred does not tire.

Deep waters roll, the floodgates pour, the depths will swallow me;
Don’t let the flood engulf me or the pit close over me.

Lord, from the goodness of Your love, in mercy turn to me.
Don’t hide Your face, for I’m distressed; come answer speedily.

Come near and rescue me, O God; redeem me from my foes;
You know I’m scorned, disgraced and shamed; my enemies You know.

Their scorn has left me helpless and my heart is torn in two;
No one gives comfort, sympathy; I have no one but You.

They gave me gall in food to eat, and vinegar to drink;
Now may their table be a trap, a snare they would not think.

May their eyes be dark as the blind; their backs be ever bent.
Pour wrath on them and let them know the anger You have sent.

May their place be deserted and let none be there to dwell;
For they wound those You strike, O Lord; my pain they love to tell.

Charge them with crime on crime, my God; don’t let them know Your grace.
May they be blotted from Your book, nor live to see Your face.

I am in pain and in distress; God, save and lift up me;
And I will praise Your name in song, to God my thanks will be.

And this will please the Lord far more than ox or bull with horn.
The poor will see and will be glad, who seek God night and morn.

The Lord hears those who cry in need; He does not turn away.
Let heav’n, earth, sea, and all therein, to Him give praise each day.

For God will save all Zion and rebuild the cities there;
His people will possess the land of Judah, settling there.

Their children will inherit it—all those who love His name;
They’ll dwell there, all His servants and their children, free from shame.

title: Psalm 70
lyrics:
O God, deliver me; O Lord, make haste—help me!
Let those who seek my life be shamed, humiliated be.

May all who seek my end, my ruin to my face—
May they be put to shame and all be turned back in disgrace.

May those who say to me, “Aha, Aha!” in spite—
May they be turned back in their shame, dishonored in plain sight.

But may all who seek You be glad, with joy abide.
May those who love salvation say, “Let God be magnified!”

Still I’m afflicted, God, make haste to help, I pray;
You’re my help and deliverer; O Lord, do not delay!

title: Psalm 71
lyrics:
In You, O Lord, I refuge take,
Do not let me be put to shame.
Come rescue and deliver me,
In righteousness of Your great name.

O turn Your ear to me and save,
And be my rock of refuge, Lord—
The place where I can always go;
You are my rock and fortress sure.

Deliver me, O Lord my God,
From hands of wicked, evil men.
For You have been my sovereign Lord,
My hope since youth, and confidence.

From birth I have relied on You;
You brought me from my mother’s womb.
I’ll praise You—I’m a sign to all,
For You’re my strength when troubles loom.

My mouth is ever filled with praise,
I tell Your splendor all day long.
Don’t cast me off when I am gray,
Forsake me not when my strength’s gone.

For enemies against me speak;
They wait and plot to kill me; then
they say, “God has forsaken him;
Seize him, for none will rescue him.”

So be not far from me, O God;
Come quickly, O my God; help me!
May my accusers die in shame,
Disgrace and scorn their cov’ring be.

But as for me, I always hope,
I’ll praise You ever with a song.
My mouth will tell Your righteousness,
And Your salvation all day long.

I will proclaim Your mighty acts,
O Sovereign Lord upon the throne.
I will proclaim Your righteousness—
The righteousness that’s Yours alone.

Since youth, You’ve taught me, O my God,
I tell Your deeds unto this day.
O God, do not forsake me now,
Not even when I’m old and gray.

For I’ll declare Your pow’r to all,
to generations yet to be.
Your righteousness does reach the skies;
You’ve done great things—who is like Thee?

Though You have sent me troubles and
made many bitter days appear;
You will restore my life again,
From depths You’ll bring me to come near.

You will increase my honor and
bring comfort once again to me.
I’ll praise You with the harp, O God,
For all Your faithfulness to me.

I’ll praise You with the lyre and sing,
O Holy One of Israel;
My lips will shout for joy; I’ll bring
my songs of praise—to all I’ll tell.

I, whom You have redeemed, will tell
Your righteous acts and deeds all day;
For all who wish to do me harm,
Shamed and confused, are put away.

title: Psalm 72
lyrics:
O God, fill the king with Your justice anew,
And his royal son with Your righteousness, too.
Then he’ll judge Your people in true righteousness,
And all the afflicted with justice he’ll bless.

The people will flourish like mountains around,
And righteousness like fruit from hills will abound.
For he will defend all the needy and save ‘ their children;
put those who oppress in the grave.

And he will endure for as long as the sun;
As long as the moon—through all ages that run.
He’ll be like the rain falling on a mown field;
Like showers that water the earth, fruit to yield.

In his days the righteous will flourish, stand sure,
Abundance abound till the moon is no more.
