He slumbers not nor sleeps.

The Lord’s your keeper; He keeps watch—
He’s shade at your right hand.
The sun won’t harm you in the day,
Nor moon at night—you’ll stand!

The Lord will keep you from all harm;
Your life He watches o’er.
The Lord guards as you come and go
both now and evermore.

title: Psalm 122
lyrics:
I was so glad when they said unto me,
“Let us go up to the house of the Lord.”
Our feet are standing here within your gates,
O bless’d Jerusalem, of all adored.

See now Jerusalem, the city great,
Built as a city close—compacted well;
To which the tribes go up—tribes of the Lord,
To praise His name, as He told Israel.

There stand the thrones for judgment set by God—
Thrones of the house of David for the land.
Pray for the peace now of Jerusalem:
“May all who love you prosper well, and stand.

“May there be peace within your walls always;
Prosperity within your citadels.”
So for the sake of brothers and of friends,
I will say, “Peace be with you, peace in full.”

Peace be within you, the peace of our God.
So, for the sake of the house of the Lord,
I will seek your prosperity and good,
O bless’d Jerusalem, of all adored.

title: Psalm 123
lyrics:
I lift my eyes up unto You—
To You enthroned in heav’n.
As eyes of servants to their lord,
So will my gaze be giv’n.

Just as a maiden’s eyes look to
her mistress, whom she knows;
So our eyes look to the Lord God,
Till He His mercy shows.

Have mercy on us, Lord, we pray,
For we’ve endured much scorn;
Endured contempt from proud who scoff—
their ridicule we’ve borne.

title: Psalm 124
Psalm 125
lyrics:
Those who trust in the Lord
are like Mount Zion’s hill;
Which can’t be shaken, but endures
forever firmly still.

As mountains do surround
your walls, Jerusalem;
The Lord surrounds His people now,
And evermore keeps them.

The reign of wicked ones
will not remain or stand,
Over the place allotted to
the righteous and their land.

For then the righteous might
do evil with their hand.
O Lord, do good to those good ones
who in uprightness stand.

But those who turn aside
to crooked, evil ways;
The Lord will banish with all wrong—
Peace be on Isr’el’s days.

title: Psalm 126
lyrics:
When the Lord brought back to Zion
captives from the exile land;
We were like those who were dreaming,
Those restored to health again.
Then our mouths were filled with laughter,
Tongues with songs of joy again;
Then they said among the nations,
“God has done great things for them!”

The Lord has done great things for us;
We are filled with joy and praise.
Lord, restore our fortunes to us
like streams in the desert place.
Those who sow with tears and weeping
will return with joyful song;
Sowing seed will bring forth reaping—
Sheaves that to the Lord belong.

title: Psalm 127
lyrics:
Unless the Lord does build the house,
The builders work in vain;
Unless the Lord the city guards,
The watchmen guard in vain.

It’s vain for you to early rise,
And late at work to keep;
To eat the bread of anxious toil—
He grants His loved ones sleep.

For children are your heritage,
The Lord’s great gift in truth;
Like arrows in the warrior’s hand
are children of one’s youth.

How bless-ed is the man who has
a quiver full of them;
They’ll not be shamed when in the gate
with foes they do contend.

title: Psalm 128
lyrics:
Bless’d are all those who fear the Lord,
Who walk within His ways.
You’ll eat the fruit of all your work,
And bless’d will be your days.

Your wife will be a fruitful vine
in your home, full of peace;
Your children round your table will
be like young olive trees.

For thus the one shall bless-ed be
who fears the Lord indeed.
Jerusalem’s prosperity,
May He bless you to see.

From Zion may the Lord bless you;
May all your days be well;
And may you see your children’s seed—
Peace be to Is-ra-el!

title: Psalm 129
lyrics:
They have oppressed me from my youth,
Let Is-ra-el now say—
They have oppressed me from my youth,
But no vict’ry have they!

Though plowmen have plowed up my back,
And made their furrows long;
The Lord, who’s righteous, cut the cords,
And freed me from their wrong!

May all who view Zion with hate
be turned back in great shame;
May they be like grass on the roof
that withers without name.

They’ll be like withered grass which dies
before it e’en can grow;
Which cannot fill the reaper’s hands
or arms for use below.

May those who pass by never say,
“The Lord’s blessing on you”;
Nor say, “We bless you in the name
of the Lord ever true.”

title: Psalm 130
lyrics:
Out of the depths I cry to You,
O Lord, now hear my voice!
Let Your ears be attentive to
my cry for mercy voiced.

If You, O Lord, recorded sins,
Then who, O Lord, could stand?
But with You there’s forgiveness, and
therefore, we fear Your hand.

I wait, my soul waits for the Lord;
His word’s my hope and stay.
My soul waits for the Lord more than
the watchmen wait for day.

Yes, more than watchmen wait for morn,
for morning, which will come;
O Is-ra-el, hope in the Lord
from Him your hope will come.

For with the Lord is steadfast love,
Redemption full and free;
And He will redeem Is-ra-el
From all iniquity.

title: Psalm 131
lyrics:
O Lord, my heart’s not proud,
Nor haughty are my eyes.
I don’t chase after matters great
or things for me too wise.

But I have stilled my soul
in quietness and rest;
Like a weaned child in peace does lie
upon its mother’s breast.

O Is-ra-el, now hope
forever in the Lord.
Let all God’s people hope in Him
both now and evermore.

title: Psalm 132
lyrics:
O Lord, remember David and all he did endure.
He made a vow unto You, an oath to God he swore:
“I won’t rest in my own house, or let my eyelids close,
Till I provide a dwelling where the Lord can repose.

“The Mighty One of Jacob must have a dwelling place.”
We heard it in Eph-ra-thah; found it in wooded space.
Let us go to His dwelling and worship at His feet.
Arise, O Lord, and come there—You and Your ark of strength.

May priests be clothed with justice; Your saints with joy all sing.
For David’s sake, Your servant, do not reject Your king.
You swore an oath to David, an oath You’ll not revoke.
The Lord has sworn to David; these words He surely spoke:

“One of your own descendants I’ll place upon your throne;
If your sons keep My cov’nant, the law I teach alone.
Then their sons will forever upon your throne rule well.”
The Lord has chosen Zion, the place He longs to dwell.

“This is My place of respite, here will I sit enthroned;
For I have much desired it—My resting place alone.
I’ll bless her with abundance; the poor will be well fed;
I’ll clothe priests with salvation, her saints with joy be led.

“Here in this place for David, I’ll make a horn to grow;
And raise a lamp for him—the anointed one I know.
His enemies will ever be clothed with scorn and shame,
But on his head the crown will be glorious with his fame.”

title: Psalm 133
lyrics:
How good it is, and pleasant, too—
A witness pure and right;
When brothers live in unity,
Together in delight.

It is like oil poured on the head
and running down the beard;
Which, running down on Aaron’s beard,
E’en to his robes appeared.

It’s like if Hermon’s dew upon
Mount Zion would be poured;
For there the Lord His blessing gives—
E’en life forevermore.

title: Psalm 134
lyrics:
Bless the Lord, all you His servants,
All you servants of the Lord;
You who serve by night within the
sanctuary of the Lord.

Lift your hands up, bless the Lord where
in the Holy Place you stand.
May the Lord who made the heav’ns and
earth bless you from Zion’s land.

title: Psalm 135
lyrics:
Praise the Lord! O praise the Lord’s name; praise Him, servants of the Lord—
You who serve within the Lord’s house; in the courts of God the Lord.
Praise the Lord, for that is pleasant; sing praise to His name alone.
For the Lord has chosen Jacob; Is-ra-el to be His own.

I know that the Lord is great—that He is greater than all gods;
And the Lord does what He pleases, in the heav’ns, on earth abroad.
He works in the depths of seas, and from earth’s end He makes the clouds;
Sends the lightning with the rain, and brings wind out of His storehouse.

He struck down all Egypt’s firstborn, of both animals and men.
He sent signs in your midst, Egypt, against Pharaoh and his men.
He struck down the many nations; killed great kings of Canaan’s land—
Sihon, king of Amorites, and Og the king of great Bashan.

He gave all their land to Isr’el, an inheritance for them.
Your name, Lord, endures forever; Your fame’s told each age again.
God will vindicate His people; have compassion upon them.
All the nations’ idols are but gold and silver, made by men.

They have mouths, but cannot speak; and they have eyes, but cannot see;
They have ears, but cannot hear; though they have mouths, they cannot breathe.
Those who make them will be like them, so will all who trust in them.
Praise the Lord, O house of Isr’el—praise the Lord, house of Aaron.

Praise the Lord, O house of Levi—praise the Lord, and Him revere.
Praise the Lord, all you who fear Him; bless the Lord who brings you near.
Praise be to the Lord from Zion, to the Lord who does there dwell;
The Lord who dwells in Jerus’lem. Praise the Lord, all Israel!

title: Psalm 136
lyrics:
O thank the Lord, for He is good; His love endures forevermore.
Give thanks to Him, the God of gods; His love endures forevermore.
Give thanks unto the Lord of lords; His love endures forevermore.
To Him alone wonders accord; His love endures forevermore.

Who made the heav’ns with wisdom great; His love endures forevermore.
Spread out the earth through waters’ gate; His love endures forevermore.
Who made the great majestic lights; His love endures forevermore.
Sun rules by day; moon, stars by night; His love endures forevermore.

Who struck down Egypt’s firstborn ones; His love endures forevermore.
And brought out Isr’el from their midst; His love endures forevermore.
With a strong hand and outstretched arm; His love endures forevermore.
He split the sea, tore it apart; His love endures forevermore.

He brought all Isr’el through the Sea; His love endures forevermore.
But Pharoah’s army swept away; His love endures forevermore.
He led His own through wilderness; His love endures forevermore.
Who smote great kings, yes, mighty kings; His love endures forevermore.

Great Sihon, king of Amorites; His love endures forevermore.
and Og the king of Bashanites; His love endures forevermore.
Who gave their land as heritage; His love endures forevermore.
As Is-ra-el’s inheritance; His love endures forevermore.

Who saw us in our low estate; His love endures forevermore.
And freed us from our enemies; His love endures forevermore.
Who gives food to His creatures all; His love endures forevermore.
Give thanks unto the God of heav’n; His love endures forevermore.

title: Psalm 137
Psalm 138
lyrics:
I’ll praise You, Lord, with all my heart; before the “gods” I’ll praise impart.
I’ll bow down toward Your holy place, and praise Your name for truth and grace.

You have exalted o’er all things, Your name and word, which true life bring.
The day I called, You answered me; You made me bold and strong to be.

May all the kings of earth praise You, Lord, when they hear Your words so true.
May they sing of the ways of God; the Lord’s great glory known abroad.

For though the Lord on high is great, yet He regards our lowly state,
And looks on those who humble are, but proud ones He knows from afar.

Though I walk in the midst of strife, e’en there You do preserve my life.
You stretch Your hand against my foes; Your right hand saves; You them oppose.

The Lord’s own purposes for me, He will accomplish and fulfill.
Your love, O Lord, forever stands; do not forsake works of Your hands.

title: Psalm 139
lyrics:
O Lord, You’ve searched and You’ve known me, know when I sit and rise;
And You perceive my thoughts from far, e’en to the farthest skies.
You scrutinize my journeying, arising, lying down;
You are familiar with my ways; You know my life throughout.

Before a word is on my tongue, O Lord, You know it all.
You hem me in, behind, before; Your hand upon me falls.
Such knowledge is too high to reach; too wonderful for me.
Where from Your Spirit can I go? Where from Your presence flee?

If I go to the heav’ns or to the depths, You’re surely there.
If I take wings of dawn and dwell across the sea most fair;
E’en there Your hand will guide me and Your right hand hold me fast.
If I say, “Darkness will hide me,” the darkness will not last.

Though light become as night to me, it is not so to You;
The night will shine like day because dark is as light to You.
For You did form my inmost parts; my life created whole;
You knit me in my mother’s womb and formed my very soul.

I praise You, for I’m fearfully and wonderfully made;
Your works are wonderful to me—on them my mind is stayed.
My frame was known to You and was not hidden from Your sight,
When I was made in secret depths; wrought by You far from light.

Your eyes there saw my unformed frame; and all the days for me
were written in Your book before one of them came to be.
How precious are Your thoughts to me, O God, how vast the sum!
Were I to count them, more than grains of sand they would become.

When I awake, I’m still with You; O God, would that You slay
the wicked whom I loathe—away from me, foul men, away!
They speak against You wickedly; they take Your name in vain.
I hate all those who hate You, Lord; who rise up ’gainst Your name.

I hate them with a hatred pure; count each my enemy.
Search me, O God, and know my heart and anxious thoughts—test me!
And see if any hurtful way is found in me today,
And lead me with Your presence in the everlasting way.

title: Psalm 140
lyrics:
Rescue me, O Lord, from evil, from the vio-lent protect me!
They devise plans in their hearts and stir up evil constantly.

They make tongues as sharp as serpents; poison is upon their lips. Selah
Keep me, Lord, protect me from them, for my feet they plan to trip.

Proud men hide a snare to catch me, they set traps along my way. Selah
I cry, “Lord, You are my God,” and for Your mercy I will pray.

Sovereign Lord, my strong deliver’r; for the fight, Your shield I need.
Don’t grant wicked their desires, Lord; do not let their plans succeed. Selah

May all those who do surround me be entrapped in their own lies;
Burning coals fall down upon them—thrown in fire, never to rise.

Let not slander be established anywhere the land around;
Those who slander—men of violence—may disaster hunt them down.

For I know the Lord loves justice, and upholds the needy’s cause;
And the upright ones will praise You; they will live who love Your laws.

title: Psalm 141
lyrics:
O Lord, I call upon You—do come quickly unto me;
O hear my voice when I call out, and hearken to my plea.
May my prayer be fixed before You, like incense would suffice;
May lifting of my hands be like the evening sacrifice.

Lord, set a guard upon my mouth, be watchful o’er my lips;
Don’t let my heart be drawn to wrong, for easily it slips.
Let me not practice wickedness, nor join a wicked deed,
nor go with evildoers, or their delicacies heed.

But let the righteous give reproof—it will be kindly said;
Let him rebuke me—it will be as oil upon my head.
I’ll not refuse it, but my prayer will ever still go out
against the deeds of wicked ones, who do their evil tout.

Their rulers will be thrown from cliffs, and wicked ones will learn,
That my words were well spoken and they should not such words spurn.
Then they’ll say, “As one plows the earth, so our bones there have been,
They have been scattered at the mouth of She-ol’s grave within.”

But my eyes still are fixed on You, O Sovereign Lord of grace,
I take refuge in You; don’t give me over to death’s place.
Keep me from snares they’ve laid for me; from where their traps do lie;
Let wicked fall in their own nets, while I pass safely by.

title: Psalm 142
lyrics:
I cry to the Lord Most High,
Lift my voice with plaintive cry.
Lord in mercy think on me,
Hear my supplicating plea.
I pour my complaint to Him,
Tell the trouble I am in.

When my spirit does grow faint,
I trust You hear my complaint;
You do surely know my way.
In the path I walk each day
foes have hid a snare for me,
hid a trap I cannot see.

Look to my right hand and see,
No one is concerned for me.
I’ve no refuge—none who care.
I cry, “Lord, You must be there!
You’re my refuge, my portion
in the land of living ones.”

Listen to my cry and heed,
For I am in desperate need.
Save me from those who pursue,
They are not too strong for You;
Rescue me and hear my plea,
For they are too strong for me.

Set me from my prison free,
That my praise to You might be.
Righteous ones will gather ’round
to hear how You did confound.
They will all Your goodness see,
How You loved me bountif’ly.

title: Psalm 143
lyrics:
Hear my prayer, O Lord, and listen,
On Your mercy, my hope’s stayed.
In Your faithfulness, give answer;
In Your righteousness, give aid.
Do not bring me into judgment;
none are righteous in Your sight.
No one living is found righteous
when before You in Your light.

For the enemy pursues me,
crushes me down to the ground.
He makes me to dwell in darkness,
like those dead, who can’t be found.
So my spirit faints within me,
and my heart’s filled with dismay;
I remember days of old and
meditate on all Your ways.

I spread out my hands before You,
my soul thirsts like a parched land.Selah
Answer quickly, my soul faints, Lord,
Hide not, lest I sink in sand.
Let the morning bring me word of
Your unfailing love to me;
For I’ve put my trust in You and
lift my soul up unto Thee.

Show to me the way to walk in;
I lift up my soul to You.
Rescue me from all my foes, Lord,
For I hide myself in You.
Teach me how to do Your will, for
You alone, You are my God;
May Your Spirit lead me on to
level ground that’s smooth and broad.

For Your name’s sake, Lord, preserve me,
In Your care, let my life stay.
In Your righteousness, revive me;
bring me out of trouble’s way.
In Your faithful lovingkindness,
silence all my enemies,
And destroy those who afflict me;
I’m Your servant; hear my plea.

title: Psalm 144
Psalm 145
lyrics:
All my life I will extol You; bless Your name, my God and King.
Blessing daily bring before You, and Your praise forever sing.
Can a mortal search Your greatness? The Lord’s great and highly praised!
Day to day, each generation has Your acts and works upraised!

Ever glor’ous is Your splendor; on Your works I’ll meditate;
For they’ll tell of works most awesome, and I’ll tell them You are great.
Grand the mem’ry of Your goodness—righteousness shown from above.
How the Lord gives grace and mercy—slow to anger, rich in love.

I’ll declare the Lord’s great mercies over all His works displayed;
For the Lord is good and gracious, good to all that He has made.
Just ones shall rejoice and bless You; all Your works shall give You praise.
Kingdom’s glory they will speak of, and Your mighty pow’r upraise.

Let the glory of Your acts be made known to the sons of men.
Majesty and glory of Your kingdom’s reign will never end.
Never will Your reign diminish; through each age it will remain.
Over all Your kingdom stretches; everlasting Your domain.

Praise the Lord—His loving care upholds and lifts up all who fall.
Quickly He will come to rescue all bowed down who on Him call.
Raising up those who are bowed down; giving food in proper time;
So the eyes of all look to You, and Your providence they find.

The desire of every creature You provide from Your own hand;
Unto all You give so freely; fill their need on sea or land.
Very righteous is the Lord, and loving, too, in all His ways.
We know that He’s near to all who call on Him in truth and praise.

He fulfills the needs of all who fear Him, and He hears their cry.
eXtol the Lord’s name—He watches o’er them from His throne on high.
You who love Him, He’ll keep ever; but the wicked He’ll destroy.
Zealous for His praise, I’ll speak—let all flesh praise His name with joy!

title: Psalm 146
Psalm 147
lyrics:
O praise the Lord—how good it is to sing praise to our God;
How pleasant and how fitting when we sing His praise abroad!
The Lord builds up Jerusalem, and gathers those outcast;
He heals the brokenhearted, and binds up their wounds at last.

He counts the number of the stars, and calls them each by name.
Great is the Lord in pow’r and might—our minds can’t grasp His fame.
The Lord sustains the humble, and supports the ones bowed down,
But stands against the wicked ones, and casts them to the ground.

Sing to the Lord with thanks and praise; with harp, make music – sing!
He covers heaven with His clouds; to earth His rain does bring.
He makes the grass grow on the hills, provides the beasts with food;
Young ravens, too, which cry to Him—supplies them all with food.

His pleasure’s not in horse’s strength, nor in the legs of man;
The Lord delights in those who fear, who trust His loving plan.
Extol the Lord, Jerusalem, and praise your God, Zi-on!
He strengthened all your bars and gates—within you bless’d your sons.

The Lord grants peace within your walls; with wheat He satisfies.
He sends forth His command on earth; His word runs swift and flies.
He spreads the snow like wool around, and scatters frost like ash.
He hurls His hail like pebbles—who can stand His icy blast?

He sends His word and so melts them; stirs wind so waters flow;
Declares His words to Jacob and His laws for them to know.
No other nation has received His laws or known His ways;
He’s done this all for Is-ra-el; O to the Lord be praise!

title: Psalm 148
Psalm 149
lyrics:
O praise the Lord and sing to the Lord a brand-new song;
Sing praise in the assembly of saints, where praise belongs.
Let Is-ra-el rejoice in their Maker—let them sing;
Let all of Zion’s people be glad in their great King!

Let them with dancing praise Him, with tambourine and song;
With harp, make praise and music which to His name belong.
For God the Lord takes pleasure in those who are His own;
He crowns them with salvation, the humble ones alone.

Let godly ones rejoice in this honor God bestows,
And let them sing for joy on their beds when eyelids close.
May His praise fill their mouths, and a two-edged sword their hand,
To execute God’s vengeance on nations through the land.

They’ll bring God’s punishment on the peoples and their kings.
To bind their kings with fetters—for them iron shackles bring
to carry out the sentence, the judgment God accords.
This is His people’s honor, their glory—praise the Lord!

title: Psalm 150
lyrics:
O praise the Lord! Praise God within His sanc-tu-a-ry—praise!
Praise Him throughout His mighty heav’n; O praise His name always.
Praise Him for all His mighty deeds, His acts of power strong.
His greatness is most excellent—to Him all praise belongs.

Praise Him with trumpet sound so loud; praise Him with harp and lute.
Praise Him with tambourine and dance, with strings and pipes and flute.
Praise Him with clashing cymbals loud—with cymbals that resound.
Let everything that breathes now praise the Lord—let praise abound!
